name: damon
caption:
OUR FIRST PICK 🎮🏀 The crowd chanted for Ed O'Bannon. We took Damon Stoudamire, and they booed.

• 1995: our first-ever draft pick, #7
• Rookie year: 19.0 PPG, 9.3 APG, Rookie of the Year
• O'Bannon went #9 and lasted 2 NBA seasons
• 2022: Scottie Barnes wins Rookie of the Year with us: 15.3 PPG, 7.5 RPG

Better rookie year: Damon or Scottie? 👇

beats.head: OUR FIRST PICK
beats.name: DAMON
beats.vo: Our first-ever draft pick. The crowd wanted Ed O'Bannon. We took a five-foot-ten point guard named Damon Stoudamire, and the fans booed.
beats.dlg: FANS WANT ED O'BANNON.|WE TAKE DAMON. BOOS.

beats.head: ROOKIE YEAR
beats.name: DAMON
beats.vo: Year one: nineteen points, nine point three assists, and Rookie of the Year.
beats.dlg: ROOKIE OF THE YEAR:|19.0 PPG, 9.3 APG.

beats.head: THE OTHER GUY
beats.name: DAMON
beats.vo: Ed O'Bannon went ninth to New Jersey, and lasted two seasons in the league.

beats.head: SCOTTIE
beats.name: SCOTTIE
beats.vo: Twenty-six years later, Scottie Barnes won it too: fifteen points and seven and a half rebounds.
beats.dlg: 2022: SCOTTIE WINS IT TOO.|15.3 PPG, 7.5 RPG.

beats.head: BETTER ROOKIE?
beats.vo: Damon or Scottie: who had the better rookie year? Comment below.

facts.claim: Stoudamire was selected 7th (#7) overall by Toronto in the 1995 draft, the Raptors' first ever draft pick; fans chanted for Ed O'Bannon and booed the pick; 1996 Rookie of the Year
O'Bannon selected ninth overall (#9) by New Jersey in 1995; two (2) seasons in the NBA
Barnes: NBA Rookie of the Year 2022 (2021-22) with Toronto
